title: Filters
description: Explicit constraints extracted from the query or carried over from conversation state. A value object (not independently stored) — embedded inline wherever it's used.

jurisdiction.description: Explicit jurisdiction constraint, if the user named one. Null if unspecified.

effective_date.description: Date the answer should be evaluated as of. Null means 'currently effective'. Prevents silently mixing source versions (Section 3, principle 5).

scope.description: Any other explicit scoping the user gave (e.g. a specific applicant category).
